new_files.description: W5 unit test: alignedTaxRate table-driven tests building AlignedFYFacts by hand — no DB, no storage. Covers complete pair (15.61%), negative rate rejection (AVGO), rate above wacc.MaxTaxRate (50%), zero pretax, stale/nil pair with reason, NaN in either field. Only in-memory arithmetic, time, math. No credentials, no DSN, no DB access.

W5 quality tests: derived tax rate feeds ROIC, out-of-range rejection lifts confidence, incomplete pair stays configured with reason, confidence lift when derived, interest_coverage uses aligned pair, FY_MAX_AGE_DAYS from env (range [1,3650]). Fixtures from quality_test.go reused, no new Inputs construction, only TaxRate/TaxRateReason/TaxRateSource field tweaks.

W5 wacc tests: observed tax rate changes the WACC number but never reclasifies the source (remains capm_hybrid / medium). Same fixture base(), rate 15.61 vs nil, KdAfterTax and CostOfDebt computed correctly. Proves rate affects value, not taxonomy.

W5 evidence JSON: validates no DSN with real password, no tokens, no private paths. DSN entries redacted/ficticios. Verifies go test suites pass, gofmt, go vet, go build sin regresion. CA-7/CA-10 invariants confirmed.

modified_files.description: W5: import quality; derive observed tax rate from alignedFYFacts when pair fresh and complete (rateReason == "") / 100 for fraction; otherwise keep configured rate. Interest: aligned.InterestReason != '' -> interestV2 = nil (prevents cross-FY ratio mixing). Single alignedFYFacts call shared by both consumers before MetricInputV2 built.

W5: alignedTaxRate freshness-first ordering - TaxRateReason now dominates completeness check before nil/value checks. A stale anchor with complete pair is NOT derivable. Rate rejected (never clamped) outside [0, wacc.MaxTaxRate]; NaN rejected via positive-form range test. Closed vocabulary reasons.
W5: import quality; reuse existing series (already includes trio concepts) for alignedFYFacts — single FY series query per security, no second query. Align tax rate with growth WACC calculation.

W5: import quality; add interest_expense/income_tax_expense/pretax_income to qualityConcepts; call alignedFYFacts/alignedTaxRate; propagate InterestReason/TaxRateReason/AlignedInterestExpense/AlignedOperatingIncome into quality.Inputs. Single query per call site.

W5: add DefaultQualityFYMaxAgeDays=550; FYMaxAgeDays field in Config; read QUALITY_FY_MAX_AGE_DAYS via modelcfg.EnvFloatRange with range [1,3650]; default 550. ConfigFromModelConfig documents that mc does not override it.

W5: add TaxRate *float64, TaxRateSource string, InterestReason, TaxRateReason, AlignedInterestExpense, AlignedOperatingIncome to Inputs; add TaxRateSourceDerived constant; add maxTaxRate=50.0 local mirror; taxRateSource now requires TaxRate != nil to claim 'derived' (otherwise falls back to configured); derivedOutOfRange tracking with ReasonTaxRateOutOfRange appended to Reasons when rate outside [0, maxTaxRate]; in.TaxRateReason propagated into Result.Reasons; confidenceFor lifts cap when taxSource==derived AND TaxRate != nil.

W5: interest_coverage uses aligned FY pair when provided (M6c-T1). With InterestReason set, returns nil + reason; otherwise fallback to legacy lookup. AlignedOperatingIncome/AlignedInterestExpense travel through Inputs.

W5: add interest_expense/income_tax_expense/pretax_income to qualityConcepts; call alignedFYFacts/alignedTaxRate; propagate InterestReason/AlignedInterestExpense/AlignedOperatingIncome into quality.Inputs. Dry-run now logs 'reasons' and 'interest_coverage' fields (CA-4: the degradation reason of the TICKER has to be capturable from this line (GE/JNJ say tax_rate_stale here), and the interest coverage shows NULL when the aligned pair could not be used (P2-4)).

gitleaks.details: Gitleaks binary not found in this environment. Secret scanning is advisory only, using regex fallback over new and modified files. No real gitleaks scan was performed. No se encontraron credenciales/DSN en los ficheros nuevos ni modificados por analisis regex advisory.

secret_scan.regex_fallback: Fallback regex sobre los ficheros nuevos y modificados (solo advisory). Patrones buscados: passwords?=, postgres://, mysql://, api_key, secret, token, DSN, private key, .env. Escaneado todos los ficheros nuevos (w5_taxrate_test.go, w5_observed_tax_test.go, test-results/tests/abys-m6c-t1-w5.json) y modificados (analytics.go, fyfacts.go, growthwacc.go, qualityrelative.go, config.go, quality.go, solvency.go). No se encontraron patrones de secrets/DSN en ningun fichero. No hay commits con credenciales reales. Resultado: sin hallazgos de secrets por regex advisory.

destructive_test_risk.description: Los tests unitarios W5 usan exclusivamente fixtures sinteticos en memoria y t.Testing. No hay TRUNCATE, no hay borrado real de BD, no se siembra datos sensibles. Los tests operan sobre series map[string][]storage.FYPoint y estructuras AlignedFYFacts construidas en el test. Riesgo: nulo para entornos de produccion o desarrollo.

sql_analysis.note: W5 reutiliza storage.GetFYAnnualSeries existente con expansion de conceptos (trio + growthConcepts/qualityConcepts). No se introduce ningun SQL nuevo ni modificacion de queries. La expansion de conceptos en el parametro de conceptos es una lista en memoria que afecta solo al filtro SQL gia existente.

input_validation.note: W5 no recibe input del usuario final en tiempo de ejecucion. Las funciones toman ticker string y series map en tiempo de test; en produccion la series vienen de storage.GetFYAnnualSeries ya filtradas o de ConfigFromEnv. No hay validacion de entrada de usuario que requiera sanitizacion contra inyeccion SQL.

dependencies.note: Solo usa imports de stdlib Go: log/slog, time, math, fmt. Ademas imports nuevos de este mismo proyecto: internal/quality, internal/wacc, internal/modelcfg. No se agregaron nuevas dependencias externas en W5.
